breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 消化道实体瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 早期多隐匿无症状，进展期浸润胃壁及腹膜淋巴转移，转移性胃癌中位生存约1年左右；并发上消化道急性大出血、肿瘤穿孔所致弥漫性腹膜炎或幽门完全梗阻时可在数小时至数日内危及生命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早期胃癌内镜黏膜下剥离术(ESD)或根治手术5年生存率>90%；中国约80%初诊已属进展期，依托靶向HER2/CLDN18.2及PD-1免疫联合化疗可延长生存但腹膜转移控制仍困难。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 全球首款CLDN18.2单抗佐妥昔单抗(Zolbetuximab)于2024年10月获FDA批准、2025年1月获NMPA批准一线治疗胃癌；2) 德曲妥珠单抗(T-DXd)确立HER2阳性胃癌后线及一线联合地位；3) 国产CLDN18.2-ADC与CLDN18.2 CAR-T(如舒瑞基奥仑赛 CT041)在顽固腹膜转移胃癌临床试验中展现显著客观缓解。

master.definition_en: A rare spinal tumor which is highly malignant and tends to be locally invasive of surrounding neural tissue. The tumor also tends to spread throughout the neuroaxis and is often rapidly progressive. Histologically the tumors are highly cellular with nuclear and cellular pleomorphism, endothelial proliferation, mitotic figures, and, often, necrosis. This tumor has a relatively poor prognosis. Clinical features may include pain followed by rapidly progressive neurologic deficits such as extremity weakness, sensory changes, spasticity, and incontinence. (From Innocenzi et al., Clin Neurol Neurosurg 1997 Feb;99(1):1-5)

master.definition_en: Acute opioid poisoning is a rare intoxication with opioids, a large group of alkaloid analgesics, mainly characterized by miosis (pinpoint pupil), respiratory depression (bradypnea/apnea) and central nervous system depression (sedation or coma). Other manifestations include hypotension, reduced bowel motility, hypothermia and hypoglycemia. Naloxone, a competitive inhibitor of the mu-opioid receptor, is a potent antagonist and is used as the antidote for opioid intoxication.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。

master.definition_en: Dermatocardioskeletal syndrome, Borrone type, is a malformation syndrome characterized by a coarse facies with full lips, severe acne (acne conglobata), mitral valve prolapse, brachydactyly and vertebral abnormalities. The onset of debilitating dermato-cardio-skeletal manifestations has been reported at around puberty. With age and the progression of this disorder, osteolysis, flexion contractures of large joints, gingival hypertrophy and thick skin have been reported.

master.definition_en: A rare ophthalmic disorder characterized by a usually congenital and unilateral round or oval, gray, white, or yellowish depression in the optic disc. There may be more than one pit present in one eye, and the anomaly is most commonly found in the inferotemporal region of the optic disc, although any sector may be involved. Patients are often asymptomatic, or may present with visual field defects, in particular paracentral arcuate scotoma connected to an enlarged blind spot. A number of patients develop serous macular detachment, with loss of vision typically becoming apparent in the third or fourth decade of life.
